test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Two positive numbers differ by 2880. When the greater number is divided by the smaller number, the quotient is 6 and the remainder is 120. What is the HCF of the greater of the two given numbers and 3916?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the smaller number be **x** and the greater be **x + 2880**.

Using Division Algorithm: **Greater = 6 × Smaller + 120**

x + 2880 = 6x + 120 ⇒ 5x = 2760 ⇒ **x = 552**.

Greater number = 552 + 2880 = **3432**.

HCF(3432, 3916): 3916 − 3432 = 484. Factors of 484 are 44 × 11. Checking 44: 3432 ÷ 44 = 78, 3916 ÷ 44 = 89.

**∴ The correct answer is 44.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92c99f0e4c9759ee614bf39f4df93d9d27a120cc93a1954dde969ca256b2842d.png] 

**Given:** Difference = 2880, Quotient = 6, Remainder = 120.

Let the **smaller number** be **S** and the **greater number** be **G**.

⇒ G − S = 2880 --- (i)

⇒ G = 6S + 120 --- (ii)

Substitute (ii) in (i):

⇒ (6S + 120) − S = 2880

⇒ 5S + 120 = 2880

⇒ 5S = 2760

⇒ S = 552

Calculating the **Greater Number (G)**:

⇒ G = 552 + 2880 = 3432

Finding **HCF(3432, 3916)** using long division or factor method:

⇒ 3916 = 3432 × 1 + 484

⇒ 3432 = 484 × 7 + 44

⇒ 484 = 44 × 11 + 0

**∴ The correct answer is 44.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Division Algorithm

For any two integers, Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder, where 0 ≤ Remainder < Divisor.

Euclidean Algorithm for HCF

HCF of two numbers a and b is the same as the HCF of b and the remainder of a/b. This continues until the remainder is zero.

HCF and Difference Rule

The HCF of two numbers must also be a factor of their difference. This often helps in narrowing down options quickly.</p
